name: Restaurant, café, bakery
settings: a top-down wooden table in a Kigali restaurant
a night venue terrace with warm lights
a counter with pizza boxes ready for delivery
a home kitchen with a pan of food steaming
an overhead plate on a tray with a hand pouring the sauce
offers: LUNCH TIME promo, Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 2 PM
cta: Order on {app} or call {phone}; the area (Kicukiro Sonatube, Kimironko).
longestRunning: Magic Chef Kigali runs one dish per video (7+ ads) with the same two delivery numbers; Best Burgers shows one burger, one price (PROMO FOR 5K) and two numbers for the whole clip; BestPilau's anniversary promo puts a price ladder (35K → 27K, 20K → 15K) in the caption over a plain overhead plate. On Instagram, Kigali street food is shot hand-held in neon colour with a POV line ('POV: you're in Kigali, Rwanda... of course you're going to try the famous street food', Nyamirambo).

name: Phone and electronics shop
settings: the shop counter with boxed phones and a wall of brand logos
a seller holding the phone in the shop
hands turning two phones to show front and back
a hand fanning four phones in front of the shop shelves
an overhead unboxing on a white table, hands only
offers: DM now before stock ends (only when stock is really limited)
Swap: bring your old phone (only if offered)
cta: WhatsApp or call {phone}; the shop address and room number (Makuza Peace Plaza, Room 35).
longestRunning: Real staff, real stock and the shop address with a landmark (Makuza Peace Plaza, Room 35) build trust where phone scams are common; a seller behind the counter with a lower-third price bar and two numbers (Elohome, 8 ads live); a model badge ('iPhone 18pro and 18pro max are available On discount', 'IPHONE 13 PRO 256GB'). On Instagram the owner talks over a spread of boxed phones (90.7K likes) or peels the film off a Samsung (52.4K), with 'Call or whatsapp' and the number in the caption. What viewers ask (TikTok comments): 48% of comments on Kigali phone clips are price questions, mostly where no price is shown, plus trade-in questions ('I have a Samsung, how much should I add?') that a swap line would answer. The most-liked Rwandan phone-shop clip on TikTok (@rujamaphones, 5,200 likes) is a seller in the shop holding three boxed phones with spec cards, then Hadidja Collection (3,086) and KIBO Electronics (3,016).

name: Salon, barber, nails, beauty
settings: the salon chair with a ring light
close-ups of hands braiding
a 2x2 grid of nail colours
the salon sign and mirrors
a close-up of a real treatment in soft light, the landmark address baked in
offers: special offer any style {price} (inclusive of braids & free wash)
cta: Book on WhatsApp {phone}; the street (Roysambu, Lumumba Drive style).
longestRunning: SPOT SALON (Nairobi) ran one flat price including a free wash for 982 days; in Kigali, Prime Wellness shows a real massage with 'Available 24/7' and 'Next to DELIGHT HOTEL' on screen; Lou Aesthetic opens on a question card ('Ready to see your skin exactly how it used to be?'). Round 3 (10 Kigali spa, nail, wig and brow ads, all young): a real treatment close-up with the hours and a landmark address burned in, a black-and-gold offer card ('MICROBLADING OFFER 20K'), the number printed under the video. On Kigali TikTok the best salon clips show the client in front of the salon's logo wall and put the price in the first frame ('28k only, with extension', '36k rwf'); a printed menu with prices as frame 1 is a strong simple opener. What viewers ask: 23% price ('angahe', 15 of 20 comments on one hair-extension clip), 10% location; a price with conditions ('28k only') is asked 'is the price real?' unless the condition is in the label.
gaps: Kigali salon ads on Facebook are young (at most 24 days live) and few show a price; on Instagram the Kigali spa, hair and beauty reels reach 20 to 200 times their followers, still with no price on screen.
voice: A voice-over with word-by-word captions for a client story; otherwise the text carries it.

name: Fashion, boutique, shoes, bags
settings: a real wearer outdoors in daylight
a clothes rack in the boutique
a mannequin showing the detail
boxes of new arrivals being opened
one sneaker turned 360 degrees in one hand outdoors
cta: Send a WhatsApp message {phone}; the shop area.
longestRunning: A 5 s loop of one model walking (Modesees, 353 days) and four colours in 10 s on a real wearer (NILA BABY SHOP, 439 days) are enough; Trendy.Wear.Kigali shows one feature (a breastfeeding opening) for the whole clip with the price in the caption. Kigali sneaker sellers (9 round-3 ads) show one pair in a hand or being laced, a model label on screen ('Hoka Clifton 9'), and put the sizes and 'Call&Whatsapp' in the caption; almost none shows the price in the video. On Instagram an East African label shoots on a model in a styled showroom and makes the caption the sales page: the price in local currency, the stock ('ORANGE SOLD'), the place and 'SHOP NOW'. Kigali TikTok fashion: a locked shot with the price on the product ('8k') and the number in a lower corner, one mannequin swapping colour every 1 to 2 s, a 'MONDAY... outfit per day' week series, and street-wear tours with 'from 7.5K RWF' and the landmark ('Kisimenti Remera Behind Eco Bank'). What viewers ask: 25% price, 13% location ('Kigali is big, say the area'); a shown '8k' answered '18k' in the comments was called a lie.

music.note: afro for boutiques, energetic (a harder beat) for street wear

voice: Usually none: the text and the picture carry it.

name: Real estate (sale and rent)
settings: the gate and the front of the house at golden hour
a smooth gimbal walk-through of the living room, kitchen and bedrooms
the plot-size sign and the parking
the view from the terrace over the Kigali hills
the agent introduces the house in a selfie, then a gimbal walk-through
a site plan laid over the roadside for plots
cta: WhatsApp {phone}; district, sector and street (Kicukiro, Kanombe, Kabeza); the property ID.
longestRunning: Hills Props and IBRA open on a location stack and a yellow price box ('Ibibanza byiza Masaka inyuma Ya Gare Bigurishwa / Price: 16M'); Bosco shows '350M RWF' top-right from second 3 with a WhatsApp overlay; captions are Kinyarwanda checklists (rooms, plot size, water and power, title). On Instagram the agent walks towards the camera with the price burned in ('$575,000', 325K likes) or 'This is what $10M just under buys you here', and a comment keyword in the caption.
gaps: The highest-liked tours are American luxury homes; Kigali property ads are 30 to 90 s Facebook ads, mostly young (days to weeks).

name: School, training, courses
settings: a teacher in uniform pointing at the lesson
a classroom with students working
a notepad list filled from frame 0
students in matching overalls working on a car in the real workshop
offers: The September intake is here, grab your seat now
cta: WhatsApp {phone} to register; the campus area.
longestRunning: Action College Rwanda shows students doing the work in the real workshop, with three branch numbers in the lower third; British English Language Institute (157 days) lists the camp's specifics in the caption; Fluently's 'Don't say / Say' lesson is a before/after in one frame. Kigali school TikTok: brand-film style (the logo, the building, students walking, a drone over the campus), a student speaking to camera with subtitles, ranked lists ('Top 9 Best Secondary Schools in Rwanda') and a title card with numbers ('17 SCHOOLS | 52 DEBATES TEAMS'); the enrolment call lives in the caption ('The September intake is here, grab your seat now').
gaps: 10 Rwandan school ads on Facebook (8 from round 4: Action School, Saint Charles study-abroad, Kigali English Academy, British Council, ALX), 8 Kigali school TikToks and one Instagram tour; none shows a price.

music.note: quiet and clean; inspiring for a brand film

voice: A student or a teacher speaking, always subtitled.

name: Transport and travel (car hire, cars, tours, travel agencies)
settings: the real fleet parked in the compound
a car driving on a Kigali road
the interior and the boot opened
a walk-around of the vehicle in the showroom with the website bar on screen
offers: Save this for your Kigali trip
cta: WhatsApp / Call {phone}, burned in from second 1 to the end.
longestRunning: homeofhybrid (Kigali, 468 days) runs raw phone footage of the cars with one word sticker per beat and a permanent yellow phone bar; Judith Safaris (565 days, the longest-running Rwandan ad found) is a corporate interview with a name card and subtitles; travel agencies use a poster first frame with a schedule and a phone bar ('HIKE MOUNT JALI … HIKING EVERY DAY'), and a car dealer floats spec labels over a walk-around ('Engine size 3,604 cc'). A Nairobi car dealer's comedy skit (an influencer asking for a free car) works on Instagram. Kigali travel TikTok puts the price per day or per activity in the opening text ('50,000 RWF per day', '7$ FOR 15 MIN'), uses numbered titles ('6 THINGS TO DO IN KIGALI') with 'save this' as the call to action, and a budget in the title ('600k UGX for 3 days').
gaps: Car hire and travel together: 12 Rwandan Facebook ads and 8 Kigali TikToks; few show a price outside the car-hire clips.
voice: A vlogger's voice-over with subtitles for lists and budgets; none for the price-per-day ads.

name: Clinic, pharmacy, health
settings: the doctor in a white coat in the real consulting room
the clinic front and its sign
the reception desk
a white question card, then a soft macro of the treated area
offers: Send a message to book your consultation
cta: Call or WhatsApp {phone} (two numbers); the address with a landmark (Gishushu, Lemigo Hotel).
longestRunning: Derma Skin Clinic Rwanda runs 15+ variants since March 2026: a named doctor explains one condition in 60 s, boxed captions, the address and two numbers in every caption, the WhatsApp button; English and Kinyarwanda versions. It is the advertiser with the most live ads among the long runners (17 seen). Kigali clinic and pharmacy TikTok leads with trust: 'First Private Pharmacy In Rwanda since 1969 | 6 Branches across Kigali', the insurers ('We work with EDENCARE, SONARWA, and RSSB'), a doctor in scrubs, and ends on a clean 'CONTACT US +250 ...' card; prices appear only on shelf tags. What viewers ask: 14% location and, on one clinic, 11 of 15 comments about insurers (RSSB, MMI, Old Mutual, Mituelle).
gaps: Health claims and before/after are restricted: education and booking only. No Rwandan pharmacy ads exist in the Ad Library; herbal-remedy pages were left out as likely quackery.
voice: The doctor or the owner explaining, always subtitled.

name: Events, venues, hotels, gifts
settings: the hall dressed and lit before guests arrive
a terrace with tables set
a grid of four gift options
a poster first frame, then 3 or 4 night clips of the lounge
the venue's lit front at night, then the singer or the band inside
offers: Free hall and free decoration, you only pay for food and drink
Dial {ussd code} for your ticket (a USSD ticket code, *669*3426# style)
cta: WhatsApp {phone} to book; for a ticketed event the USSD ticket code or the ticket link, the date and the venue (Kiyovu).
longestRunning: One Click Hotel offers the hall and decoration free (pay only food and drink); Élevée Lounge's 'FRIDAY UNLOCKED / Buy 4, get 5' poster names the landmark ('opposite IPRC traffic lights') and runs every Friday; flowerbar_zanzibar's 5 s gift grid ran 652 days. Among the long runners, a Kigali residence states 'from 20,000 RWF a night' with a WhatsApp button (124 days). Round 4 (16 event ads, 13 watched): a poster or animated slide first ('RESONANCE - KIGALI'S Finest'), then venue footage at night (Essence Bar & Grill's lit front and the singer inside, Fusion's warm exterior), and the ticket route as a USSD code ('Hurry now, dial *669*3426# and get your ticket!').
gaps: 24 event and venue rows now (16 Facebook ads from round 4, a wedding décor reel and a proposal story on Instagram); few show a price, and ticket prices are rare.

name: Services (cleaning, repair, delivery, printing, garage)
settings: the team at work on site
the workshop with the tools
the finished job held still
a technician holding the router at the client's door
the finished railing or staircase held still
cta: Call or WhatsApp {phone}; the areas served.
longestRunning: Piramie 4G+ pins '20 Mbps | 20K / month' on every frame and ran 6 variants in 11 days; Royal Aluminium and Website Design Rwanda open on a loss or pain line ('Old railing rusting?', 'STOP LOSING CUSTOMERS ONLINE!') and a free quote; a renovation time-lapse got 415.7K likes on TikTok. Long-running Rwandan service ads (tax, auto service, website design, travel) run 45 to 90 s with an offer of a visit, a consultation or a discount instead of a price.

name: Agriculture (farm inputs, hydroponics, seeds, irrigation, poultry)
settings: a greenhouse or a backyard in Rwanda with the equipment running and green plants close up
a hand harvesting fresh produce into a basket
a close-up of the product doing its job (water running, plants growing, seeds sprouting)
a farm or a school garden in daylight with the equipment in the middle of the frame
a market stall or a kitchen with the fresh produce next to the price
cta: WhatsApp {phone} to order or book a visit; the farm, shop or office area when the brief gives one.
longestRunning: No research rows for agriculture yet. Until they come from the viral library, the sector borrows what works for equipment and fresh produce: the price and the number on screen from the first frame, one clear result of the product (what it grows, saves or feeds), and a short how-it-works demo.
gaps: No research rows yet: the hooks, formats and music here are borrowed from the shop and school sectors and are early evidence only. Replace them when agriculture clips are collected.

music.note: calm and fresh for growing equipment, upbeat for produce and offers

voice: A voice-over helps explain how it works in plain words (what it grows, what it saves).

name: Shop (general retail, cosmetics, kitchenware, wholesale)
settings: a tidy shop counter in a Kigali shop
a wall of stock with a hand holding one item
the shop floor with a greeting assistant
boxes of new stock
the product doing its job in a plain room, all the facts in one text block at the top
cta: WhatsApp {phone}; the shop's building and room number.
longestRunning: In Kigali, EHA 250, Titanium Smart Life and Elohome keep the price and the number on screen from frame 0 (a top text block or a lower-third bar); the cash-on-delivery sellers (Kenlina-B, Ugalina, TnzStore) ran one template for up to 24 months with 'Free delivery, pay after delivery'; Bahnasawi writes the offer in Kinyarwanda capitals over the furniture. What viewers ask: a skincare vendor that gave the offer as a percent drew 'How much?' in 8 of 15 comments; a bedding clip drew delivery and pay-on-delivery questions.
